title: Matrix Chain
prompt:
**Problem.** Line 1: n (number of matrices). Line 2: n+1
dimensions d[0..n]. Matrix i has shape d[i-1] x d[i]. Print the minimum
number of scalar multiplications.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n ≤ 300; 1 ≤ d[i] ≤ 10^5.

The canonical interval DP: split points over growing lengths.
